yogas.name: Nipuna Yoga
yogas.effect: You will be intelligent and skillful in all works. You will be well known, respected and happy.\n This yoga is the most powerful in divisional charts like D-10. In rasi chart also, it can give results if Mercury is not combust.
yogas.condition: Sun and Mercury are together (in one sign).

yogas.name: Anaphaa Yoga
yogas.effect: You will become a king with good looks. Your body is likely free from disease. You are a person of character and have great reputation. You are surrounded by comforts.
yogas.condition: There are planets other than Sun in the 12th house from Moon

yogas.name: Kedaara Yoga
yogas.effect: One born with this yoga is an agriculturist. This person is happy wealthy and helpful to others. Kedaara means a field.
yogas.condition: The seven planets occupy exactly 4 distinct signs among them.

yogas.name: Asubha Yoga
yogas.effect: One born with this yoga has many desires and is sinful and enjoys the wealth of others.
yogas.condition: Lagna has malefics or has “paapa kartari or maleefics in 12th and 2nd house from Lagna.

yogas.name: Vimala Yoga
yogas.effect: One born with this yoga is noble, frugal, happy and independent. Vimala means pure.
yogas.condition: If the 12th lord occupies the 12th house, then this yoga is present.

yogas.name: Vanchana Chora Bheethi Yoga
yogas.effect: You will face constant fear of being cheated, defrauded, or robbed by others.
yogas.condition: The Lord of Lagna is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house joined with or aspected by malefics.

yogas.name: Kedara Yoga
yogas.effect: You will be a farmer or associated with land, truthful, happy, and helpful to others.
yogas.condition: All seven planets are distributed among four different signs.

yogas.name: Dharidhra Yoga
yogas.effect: Yoga causes dire poverty, financial straits, wretchedness and miseries
yogas.condition: Lord of Lagna associated with 6th, 8th, or 12th lord and subjected to malefic aspects.

yogas.name: Dharidhra Yoga
yogas.effect: Yoga causes dire poverty, financial straits, wretchedness and miseries
yogas.condition: Natural malefics (not owning 9th or 10th) in Lagna associated with or aspected by maraka lords (L2/L7).

yogas.name: Rogagrastha Yoga
yogas.effect: You may have a weak constitution and be prone to chronic health issues or frequent illnesses.
yogas.condition: The Lagna lord is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house and is associated with the lord of the 6th.

yogas.name: Krisanga Yoga
yogas.effect: You will have a lean, thin, or emaciated physical appearance.
yogas.condition: The Navamsa Lagna is owned by a dry planet AND malefics join the Rasi Lagna.

yogas.name: Dehasthoulya Yoga
yogas.effect: You will have a stout, heavy, or corpulent body (tendency toward obesity).
yogas.condition: Lagna Lord and its Navamsa Lord both occupy watery signs (in Rasi).

yogas.name: Swaveeryaddhana Yoga
yogas.effect: You will earn wealth solely through your own efforts, hard work, and personal prowess, without much ancestral help.
yogas.condition: The Lagna lord is the strongest planet in the chart and is placed in a Kendra, associated with the 2nd lord.

yogas.name: Anthya Vayasi Dhana Yoga
yogas.effect: You will accumulate and enjoy great wealth and prosperity during the later years or the final stage of your life.
yogas.condition: The lords of the 2nd, 9th, and 11th houses are placed in the 12th, 6th, or 8th houses from each other but associated with benefics.

yogas.name: Matrumooladdhana Yoga
yogas.effect: You will inherit or gain wealth and assets through your mother or from your maternal side of the family.
yogas.condition: The 2nd lord is associated with the 4th lord or placed in the 4th house with strong benefic influence.

yogas.name: Annadana Yoga
yogas.effect: You will be very interested in feeding others and providing charity to the needy.
yogas.condition: Jupiter or the Moon has a benefic association with the 2nd or 12th house.

yogas.name: Sraddhannabhuktha Yoga
yogas.effect: You may have to eat food offered in funeral rites or ceremonies (Sraddha), or depend on others' charity for sustenance.
yogas.condition: The lord of the 2nd house is associated with Saturn and the lord of the 8th house.

yogas.name: Vakchalana Yoga
yogas.effect: You may suffer from a flickering tongue, stammering, or a lack of consistency and clarity in your speech.
yogas.condition: The lord of the 2nd house is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house, and is associated with Rahu or Saturn.

yogas.name: Bhratruvriddhi Yoga
yogas.effect: You will have an increase in the number of brothers and sisters, and enjoy a harmonious relationship with them.
yogas.condition: The 3rd lord or Mars is associated with a benefic planet or placed in a benefic sign/Navamsha.

yogas.name: Parakrama Yoga
yogas.effect: The individual will be highly courageous, valorous, and possesses great physical and mental strength to overcome obstacles.
yogas.condition: The lord of the 3rd should join a benefic navamsa being aspected by (or conjoined with) benefic planets, and Mars should occupy benefic signs.

yogas.name: Bandhu Pujya Yoga
yogas.effect: The person will be respected by his relatives and friends.
yogas.condition: 194 - The 4th house or the 4th lord should have the association or aspect of Jupiter.

yogas.name: Bandhu Bhisthyaktha Yoga
yogas.effect: The person will be clesertedby his relatives.
yogas.condition: 195. The 4th lord must be associated with malefics or occupy evil shashtiamsas or join inimical or debilitation signs.

yogas.name: Maathru Naasa yoga
yogas.effect: The person's mother will have a very early death.
yogas.condition: 198 - The Moon should be hemmed in between, associated with or aspected by evil planets.

yogas.name: Anapathya Yoga
yogas.effect: The person will have no children.
yogas.condition: Jupiter and the lords of Lagna, the 7th and the 5th are weak

yogas.name: Eka Puthra Yoga
yogas.effect: The person will have only one child.
yogas.condition: 225 - Lord of 5th house should join a kendra or trikona.

yogas.name: Kaalanirdesat Puthranaasa Yoga
yogas.effect: The person will suffer loss of children in his 32nd and 40th years respectively.
yogas.condition: 230 - Malefics should be disposed (cojoins or aspect) in 5th from Jupiter and 5th from Lagna

yogas.name: Buddhimaturya Yoga
yogas.effect: The person will be a man of great intelligence and character.
yogas.condition: 231 - If the 5th lord, being a benefic, is either aspected by another benefic or occupies a benefic sign, the above yoga is given rise to.

yogas.name: Bahu Sthree Yoga
yogas.effect: The person will have any number of wives.
yogas.condition: 238 - If the lords of the Lagna and the 7th are in conjunction or aspect with each other, the above yoga is given rise to.

yogas.name: Sathkalatra Yoga
yogas.effect: The native's wife will be noble and virtuous.
yogas.condition: 239 - The lord of the 7th or Venus should join or be aspected by Jupiter or Mercury.

yogas.name: Guhyaroga Yoga
yogas.effect: The person suffers from diseases in the private parts.
yogas.condition: 281 - The Moon should join malefics in the Navamsa of Cancer or Scorpio.

yogas.name: Mathibhramana Yoga
yogas.effect: The person becomes insane.
yogas.condition: This yoga occurs, per B.V.Raman Variations, if - (1) The 6th is occupied by Rahu and aspected by Kethu. (2) The 6th lord is further affiicted by conjunction with Mars. (3) The planet of nerves Mercury is in a common sign in conjunction with two malefics, Mars and Sun. (4) In the Navamsa again Mercury occupies the 6th with Rahu and the 6th lord is in conjunction with Mars.

Ghata Dosha.description:
Ghat Dosha occurs when there is Saturn-Mars conjunction in a horoscope. Both are malefic planets and can combine to create havoc in the native’s life. The two most extreme energies of Saturn and Mars can make the native impulsive and develop feelings of hatred, bringing about bad decisions or outbursts with a long-lasting impact. The person may feel a sense of conflict in all actions due to the restrictions from Saturn.

Mars-Saturn Conjunction in 3rd house indicates good initiative and courage which can give you more monetary gains with your hard work and effort but on the other hand, conflicts with siblings and family are visible due to your stubborn nature.

Pitru Dosha.description:
Pitru Dosha is a planetary flaw that means a karmic debt of the ancestors, which is to be paid by the person afflicted with Pitru Dosha in the Kundli. It is formed when your forefathers have committed any mistakes, crimes, or sins in their life journey. In return, you have to pay the karmic debt by experiencing different challenges or punishments in your life. This Dosha is created when Sun or Moon are in conjunction or aspects Rahu or Ketu in your birth chart. The malefic effects of this Dosha become severe when the conjunction takes place in the 1st, 5th, 8th, or 9th house of the birth chart. Hence, if you are facing never-ending troubles, Pitru Dosha may be the reason for the pain and agony in your life.
There is pitru dosha in this horoscope for the following reasons:

Either sun, moon or Rahu is in ninth house.

Either sun, moon, rahu or ketu has been afflicted by malefic planets like Mars or Saturn

Sun or Moon is in conjunction with Rahu or Ketu.

Shrapit Dosha.description: There is no shrapit dosha in this horoscope

Guru Chandala Dosha.description: There is no Guru Chandal dosha on this horoscope.
